formatHint.hevc: Smaller files, best when HEVC decoding is smooth.
formatHint.h264: Highly compatible and generally quick to decode.
formatHint.webp: Silent grid preview with no audio track.

generation.engineHint: Auto selects the best engine that actually works.
generation.presetHint: Actual FFmpeg values for the selected engine.
generation.resolutionHint: 480p is the default setting for cards.
generation.audioHint: Adds a lightweight AAC track to video proxies.
generation.noWebpAudio: Animated WebP does not support audio.
generation.audioUnavailable: No audio in the configured preview.
generation.thumbnailFormatHint: WebP is often smaller; JPEG remains universal.
generation.qualityHint: The step sets both detail and generation speed.
generation.thumbnailTiming: The thumbnail is still captured a few frames after the cut in fast mode.
generation.cacheHint: Existing caches remain available after a change.

performance.shotDecodeHint: Pulls a shot's frames in one go instead of one by one. Up to 6× faster, for exactly the same frames.
performance.vramProfileHint: How much work runs at once. Lower it if the app gets in the way of your edit, raise it if the machine is free.
performance.maxPatchesHint: How much detail the model sees in each frame. Higher catches small elements, but costs time and memory.
performance.reindexWarning: At this resolution your rushes must be indexed again. Going back to 256 finds the original index intact.
performance.onnxGpuHint: About 8× faster than the processor, for the same results. Turn it off if your graphics driver crashes.

outbox.intro: Close Resolve/Premiere Pro to free the GPU during heavy encodes without losing your sends: they are cached and applied automatically when the app reopens.
outbox.enabledHint: Otherwise, sending to a closed editing app fails as before.
outbox.delayHint: Gives the editing app time to finish opening.
outbox.targetSingleHint: All pending sends go to one timeline, created when the app reopens.
outbox.targetNewHint: Each send creates its own timeline, just like a direct send.

offline.title: Offline timeline cache
offline.none: No cache — with Resolve closed, timelines open empty.
offline.needResolve: Resolve must be connected to build the cache.
offline.building: Updating in the background (media keeps priority)…
offline.auto: Updates automatically in the background and reads only new timelines.

discord.title: Discord presence

status.searching: Can't find Discord — presence shows up once it's open.

discord.customHelp: Replaces the automatic lines. {module} and {projet} get substituted.

storage.emptyHint: Thumbnails and previews get indexed as you browse footage.

kindHint.thumb: One image per shot. Slow to rebuild from cold.
kindHint.proxy: Short clips encoded on GPU. Rebuilt in a second.
kindHint.voice: 16 kHz WAV for transcription and silence detection.
kindHint.roto: Frames and masks from segmentation sessions.
kindHint.scenes: AI-detected cut points. Rebuild = one detection pass.
kindHint.transcripts: Text and word timings. Rebuild = one ASR pass.
kindHint.embeddings: One vector per shot — what the model saw. Rebuild = hours of GPU.
kindHint.indexThumbs: Old thumbnails left inside the index. Search now shows the ones from cutting, so whatever remains here can go.
kindHint.faces: One identity vector per detected face. Rebuild = one detection pass.

tree.title: By project
tree.desc: Grouped by source folder. Clear what belongs to a finished project without touching the rest.
tree.unattributedHint: Cache written before the index, or whose footage couldn't be found. Can be purged all at once.

reindex.hint: Picks up cache already on disk: the index only knows what was written since it landed.

dir.title: Cache folder
dir.desc: Applies to thumbnails and video previews. The database and models stay put.
dir.moveDesc: {{size}} already sit in the old folder. Moving them saves a full rebuild.
dir.leaveHint: The old folder stays listed here and can be deleted.

lifecycle.sessionDesc: Frames, masks and tests used while current edits are in progress.
lifecycle.reusableDesc: Rebuilt on their own whenever they are missing.
lifecycle.durableDesc: Expensive results are only removed when you ask.

policy.title: Automatic cleanup
policy.desc: Fast previews are bounded by default. Expensive analyses stay saved.
policy.quotaHint: Past this, the least recently used entries go first.
policy.ageHint: Deletes anything unused for this long.
policy.manualOnlyHint: This type isn't usage-tracked: no auto-purge possible.
policy.sessionDesc: Choose when each large derivative stops being useful. App exit always remains the safety net.
policy.sequenceHint: Frame folders created only to feed a model. User-exported sequences are never touched.
policy.sessionOnlyHint: The whole folder is removed when NetsuRush closes and checked again on the next launch after a crash.

confirm.title: Delete this cache?
confirm.descKinds: {{size}} will be freed. The content rebuilds when needed.
confirm.descSources: {{size}} will be freed for these clips ({{count}}). Other footage isn't touched.
confirm.descUnattributed: {{size}} of unattributed cache will be freed.
confirm.expensive: The search index is included: rebuilding it takes hours of GPU.

maintenance.title: Maintenance
maintenance.desc: Two corners that per-project cleanup doesn't cover.

missing.title: Missing footage
missing.desc: Unplugging an external drive is enough to make it vanish: nothing gets deleted without you.

db.title: Database
db.vacuumHint: A purge leaves the space reserved in the file. Compacting gives it back to the disk.
db.vacuumBusy: Can't do this while a task is using the database. Close what's running and try again.

projects.desc: Search is limited to the open project by default. A project joins this list once NetsuRush has read its Media Pool. Scanning opens each Resolve project in turn to collect its footage, then reopens the original one — useful for projects indexed before this list existed.
projects.forgetTooltip: Removes the project from the list (index and files are untouched)
projects.title: Projects known to search

navigation.title: Pages and navigation order
navigation.subtitle: Hide pages you do not use and choose their order in the sidebar.

detection.reindexHint: Another model draws different shot boundaries: rushes already indexed will have to be indexed again.

indexing.title: Indexing
indexing.subtitle: Rushes are first cut into shots, then each shot is analysed. Settings that change nothing in the results are already on.
